notes: Directory sources list a Coburg DC at Sonntagsanger 1; DC Hub reports operational with 3.0 MW; directory-derived capacity/status.

name: centron data center Coburg
notes: centron press release (2020-10-27) lists Coburg among its existing data centers (Nürnberg, Coburg, Frankfurt am Main, Hallstadt). May correspond to the NGZ/UnitedColo Sonntagsanger facility given centron's hosting heritage; not independently address-verified.

name: Autoliv Dachau Rechenzentrum
notes: Glos Doppelbodensysteme reference list records 'Rechenzentrum Autoliv Dachau' as a July 2022 new-build raised-floor project (customer Rittal). Weak/indirect evidence; no capacity or address found; no other Dachau-district DC evidence in method search.

name: TH Deggendorf Lehr- und Test-Datacenter
developer: Technische Hochschule Deggendorf / Verband Innovative Rechenzentren e.V.
notes: Datacenter-Insider reported a planned teaching/test data center for TH Deggendorf with four independent edge DC rooms (4 racks each); THD 2022 press item confirms Data-Center Management program and VIRZ cooperation. No completion evidence found in this round.

name: Bundeswehr Information Technology Center, IT-Bataillon 292, Dillingen
notes: Reports describe a deployable protected ITC/Rechenzentrum commissioned and tested at Informationstechnikbataillon 292 in Dillingen an der Donau - 31 protected shipping containers plus support containers, supplied by Atos.

No public datacenter project/facility found. ColocationIX 'Rechenzentrum Dingolfing' page is target-marketing for its Bremen DC (not a local facility); BMW Group plant Dingolfing runs internal plant IT but no public dedicated DC project evidence surfaced.

name: Sonextis Rechenzentrum Donauwörth
notes: Sonextis operates its own certified Rechenzentrum in Donauwörth/Riedlingen (Dr.-Friedrich-Drechsler-Straße 12), built with Schneider Electric; opened 2024-07-06, ~EUR 15M, first data center in Landkreis Donau-Ries; office-roxx (Sept 2025) confirms completed modern RZ building; serves medical/Arztpraxen customers.

name: Freistaat Bayern Rechenzentrum Markt Schwaben
notes: Public procurement by Staatliches Bauamt München 1: highly available state data center with office area in Markt Schwaben (Landkreis Ebersberg), 18,364 sqm site / ~13,000 sqm usable floor, VK3 availability, target PUE 1.2, EUR 240M gross cost cap. No construction start found in this round - still planned.

name: Kirchliches Rechenzentrum Eichstätt / Diocese of Eichstätt data center
notes: Official Diocese page identifies the Kirchliche Rechenzentrum Eichstätt as IT service provider for church/diaconia/Caritas customers; local reporting: green electricity, ~40,000 users, PUE 1.16; MW not disclosed.

name: Catholic University of Eichstätt-Ingolstadt KU Rechenzentrum
notes: KU official page identifies its Rechenzentrum as internal IT service provider; KU reported a major IT infrastructure project in Eichstätt and Ingolstadt started after 2017 planning; Datacenterplatform lists the Eichstätt site at Ostenstraße 26. MW not disclosed.

name: Amadeus Erding Data Centre
notes: Amadeus official material describes the Erding facility as integral to operations and one of the largest privately owned data centers in Europe; careers page: opened 1990, 500+ staff; DCD corroborates Erding DC. No MW disclosed.

name: YEXIO Edge-Rechenzentrum Dorfen
developer: YEXIO / HOCHTIEF Data Center Partner GmbH (spin-off of HOCHTIEF PPP Solutions) & Palladio Partners
notes: Bavarian StMWI press release 82/2026 (2026-03-02): Spatenstich for YEXIO edge data center in Dorfen (Landkreis Erding); modular timber building ~30x40 m, 12 m high; initially ~2 MW IT, expandable to 4 MW; commissioning planned mid-2027; waste heat feeds Stadtwerke Dorfen district heating (~400 houses per SZ). Land purchase contract signed 2025-06-26 (Stadt Dorfen). Third YEXIO edge DC after Heiligenhaus (2024) and Herne (2026) - part of planned 25-edge-DC network.

name: North Bavarian High-Performance Computing Center at FAU / NHR@FAU new building
developer: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg; Free State of Bavaria
notes: FAU reported construction started at Campus Erlangen South for the Erlangen National HPC Center after EUR 270M+ funding approval; DCD reports expansion will provide 10 MW for northern Bavarian universities; nordbayern calls it a 'gigantic data center' (Freistaat crosses EUR 1.5 bn in FAU new-builds).

name: Regionales Rechenzentrum Erlangen (RRZE)
notes: RRZE official pages identify the university computing center and central IT services at Martensstraße 1, 91058 Erlangen; Datacenterplatform lists 'Regionales Rechenzentrum Erlangen' at the same address. MW not disclosed.

name: NHR@FAU Helma AI / HPC cluster installation
notes: FAU inaugurated 'Helma' at NHR@FAU - most powerful supercomputer at German universities; FAU is the Bavarian AI computing center; compute expansion within the Erlangen university DC environment; MW not separately disclosed.

name: adidas AG Global IT Herzogenaurach data center
notes: Data-center design firm CWDC lists 'adidas AG - Global IT Herzogenaurach' as technical renovation of a data center (planning/tendering/CM); 2026 SPIE job listing for Herzogenaurach points to fixed-site data center work; adidas careers confirms Herzogenaurach HQ. Capacity/current operator not disclosed.

name: Siemens Healthineers Forchheim sites with data center infrastructure (office/development building, HEP Center, Detector Center)
notes: Siemens Healthineers HEP Center Forchheim (EUR 350M, opened 2024) is its first fully digitized production/research campus; Apleona reference describes the office/development building as including a Rechenzentrum; lcmd Detector Center (EUR 80M, 9,000 sqm) scope includes data center infrastructure. Enterprise DCs rather than colocation; MW not disclosed.

name: Landkreis Freising school data center at Wippenhauser Straße vocational school center
notes: SZ (2020-07-03): Landkreis Freising planned its own data center for district schools at the Wippenhauser Straße vocational school site; district committee 2020 resolution: 75 sqm Rechenzentrum for district schools to be included in competition planning; Landkreis IuK page confirms central IT infrastructure operation. No later operational confirmation found.

name: Thomas-Krenn Freyung data center / show data center and in-house infrastructure
notes: Thomas-Krenn official 2012 announcement: Freyung building expansion emphasized in-house data center and showroom ('Show-Rechenzentrum'); DataCenter-Insider reported 2026 opening of a further Freyung production-site expansion; storage-insider lists HQ at Speltenbach-Steinäcker 1, 94078 Freyung. 2021 Yorizon JV (Thomas-Krenn + HOCHTIEF PPP Solutions) targets sustainable regional DCs, but its pilot is in Heiligenhaus (NRW), not Freyung. MW not disclosed.

name: LDBV Freyung IT and geodata services site
developer: Bavarian State Office for Digitization, Broadband and Surveying (LDBV)
notes: LDBV official release: Freyung branch at Bahnhofstraße 10 opened in renovated premises 2026-04-20, handling IT and geodata services, ALKIS operation, central procurement, BayernAtlas operations. Public-sector IT operations site rather than colocation/hyperscale; MW not disclosed.
